validation_queries.description: Verify that 'rocm_hipfile_api' appears in category at least once in table regions
validation_queries.error_message: 'rocm_hipfile_api' category entries are fewer than expected in regions
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM regions WHERE category = 'rocm_hipfile_api';

validation_queries.description: Ensure there are no hipFILE API calls that last 0 seconds
validation_queries.error_message: Found hipFILE API captures where duration is 0
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM regions WHERE category = 'rocm_hipfile_api' AND duration = 0;

validation_queries.description: Verify that 'rocm_hipfile_api' string is present in the table
validation_queries.error_message: 'rocm_hipfile_api' string not found in the table rocpd_string
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rocpd_string WHERE string LIKE '%rocm_hipfile_api%';
